label.en: WEA compared with the pre-crisis level (discontinued)

units.en: Scaled to the rate of growth of real, seasonally, calendar and sport-event adjusted GDP versus the same quarter of the previous year (percent)

notes: Weekly indicator published by SECO. The headline series (seco_wwa) runs from 2005; seco_wwa_pre_covid is a discontinued variant (2019-2022) measuring activity relative to the Q4 2019 level.
concept: Business cycle & sentiment / High-frequency activity tracker
